class RegistryV3
  registrations(cursor: str, limit: int) -> Page
  register(registration: RegistrationSpec) -> Change
  replace(expected_revision: str, registration: RegistrationSpec) -> Change
  remove(expected_revision: str, facet: FacetReference) -> Change
  set_enabled(expected_revision: str, facet: FacetReference, enabled: bool) -> Change
  observe(cursor: str, wait_ms: int) -> Page

  __init__(transport)
  registrations(cursor: str, limit: int) -> Page

  set_enabled(expected_revision: str, facet: FacetReference, enabled: bool) -> Change
  observe(cursor: str, wait_ms: int) -> Page
